results.query: transformer top oil temperature above rating loss of life IEEE C57.91 loading guide
results.snippet: Heat is one of the most common destroyers of transformers. Operation at only 10 °C above the transformer rating will cut transformer life by 50%. Heat is caused by internal losses due to loading, high ambient temperature, and solar radiation.
